findings.title: No [build-system] table declared in pyproject.toml
findings.consequence: Editable installs may behave inconsistently across pip versions without an explicit build backend.
findings.requiredBehavior: pyproject.toml should declare a [build-system] table (e.g. setuptools) so packaging is reproducible.

evidenceGaps: CI workflow presence was not independently confirmed for this fixture.
biggestConstraint: No declared build backend makes packaging behavior implementation-defined.
